articles.title_en: Labor Market Effects of Credit Constraints: Evidence from a Natural Experiment
articles.title_cn: 信贷约束的劳动力市场效应：来自自然实验的证据
articles.abstract_en: We exploit the 1997 and 2003 constitutional amendments in Texas—allowing home equity loans and lines of credit for nonhousing purposes—as natural experiments to estimate the effect of easier credit access on the labor market. Using state-level as well as micro data, we find that easier access to housing credit led to a notably lower labor force participation rate between 1997 and 2007. Our findings are remarkably robust to improved synthetic control methods based on insights from machine learning. Our research shows that negative labor market effects of easier credit access are important for assessing its stimulative impact on overall growth. (JEL C45, G21, G51, J16, J22)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们利用得克萨斯州1997年和2003年的宪法修正案——允许房屋净值贷款和信用额度用于非住房目的——作为自然实验，来估计更容易获得信贷对劳动力市场的影响。使用州级和微观数据，我们发现更容易获得住房信贷导致1997年至2007年间劳动力参与率显著降低。我们的发现在基于机器学习见解的改进合成控制方法下非常稳健。我们的研究表明，更容易获得信贷的负面劳动力市场效应对于评估其对整体增长的刺激影响很重要。(JEL C45, G21, G51, J16, J22)

articles.title_en: Learning by Offending: How Do Criminals Learn about Criminal Law?
articles.title_cn: 通过犯罪学习：罪犯如何了解刑法？
articles.abstract_en: This paper investigates how criminals learn about criminal laws. It uses a natural experiment in which sentences were drastically increased for a specific type of recidivism in France. In the short run, advertising the reform did not trigger any change in criminal behavior. However, people who had firsthand experience of the reform learned about it and later committed significantly fewer targeted crimes, but the same number of nontargeted crimes. Learning appears to be limited to individuals with direct experience of the law. While codefendants also learned, other criminal peers and defendants attending the same trial for another case did not. (JEL D83, K14, K42)
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了罪犯如何了解刑法。本文利用了一项自然实验，在该实验中，法国对特定类型的累犯大幅提高了刑罚。在短期内，宣传改革并未引发犯罪行为的变化。然而，亲身经历过改革的人了解到了这一点，随后显著减少了目标犯罪，但非目标犯罪的数量不变。学习似乎仅限于直接接触法律的个人。虽然共同被告也学到了，但其他犯罪同伙和因另一案件参加同一审判的被告则没有。（JEL D83, K14, K42）

articles.title_en: Gender Differences in Preferences for Meaning at Work
articles.title_cn: 工作中意义偏好的性别差异
articles.abstract_en: Scholars have examined whether preferences for job characteristics help explain why men and women sort into different occupations but have overlooked preferences for meaning at work. We first document gender differences in preferences for meaning in a large-scale survey covering individuals in 47 countries. We then conduct a choice-based conjoint analysis of a cohort of MBA students at a leading business school to study gender differences in preferences for meaning compared to other job attributes. We show that gender differences in preferences for meaning at work are widespread and partly explain gender differences in behavioral outcomes, including industry of work. (JEL D91, I23, J16, J24, J28)
articles.abstract_cn: 学者们研究了工作特征偏好是否有助于解释男性和女性为何进入不同的职业，但忽视了工作中意义偏好的作用。我们首先在一项覆盖47个国家个体的大规模调查中记录了工作中意义偏好的性别差异。然后，我们对一所顶尖商学院的一批MBA学生进行了基于选择的联合分析，以研究与其他工作属性相比，意义偏好的性别差异。我们表明，工作中意义偏好的性别差异普遍存在，并部分解释了行为结果（包括工作行业）的性别差异。（JEL D91, I23, J16, J24, J28）

articles.title_en: Did the Paycheck Protection Program Help Small Businesses? Evidence from Commercial Mortgage-Backed Securities
articles.title_cn: 薪资保护计划是否帮助了小企业？来自商业抵押贷款支持证券的证据
articles.abstract_en: In this study, we examine the broader economic effects of the US federal government’s Paycheck Protection Program by focusing on the performance of securitized commercial mortgages. We provide novel evidence for spillover effects of government interventions in the face of economic crises. We find that the PPP reduced mortgage delinquencies by approximately $36 billion in 2020. The strongest effects occur when PPP funds targeted businesses in areas most affected by COVID-19, where banks overperformed in providing PPP loans, and among mortgages on properties in retail and lodging. Thus, PPP relief to small businesses eased economic distress beyond the labor market. (JEL G21, G28, I12, I18, L25, R33)
articles.abstract_cn: 在本研究中，我们通过关注证券化商业抵押贷款的表现，考察了美国联邦政府薪资保护计划的更广泛经济效应。我们为经济危机中政府干预的溢出效应提供了新的证据。我们发现，PPP在36年将抵押贷款违约率降低了约2020亿美元。当PPP资金针对受COVID-19影响最严重地区的企业时，效果最强，这些地区的银行在提供PPP贷款方面表现超常，且对零售和住宿物业的抵押贷款效果显著。因此，对小企业的PPP救助缓解了劳动力市场之外的经济困境。（JEL G21, G28, I12, I18, L25, R33）

articles.title_en: Intergenerational and Sibling Spillovers in High School Majors
articles.title_cn: 高中专业选择中的代际与兄弟姐妹溢出效应
articles.abstract_en: This paper estimates family spillovers in high school major choice in Sweden, where admission to oversubscribed majors is determined based on GPA. Using a regression discontinuity design, we find large sibling and intergenerational spillovers that depend on the sex mix of a dyad. Same-sex siblings copy one another, while younger brothers recoil from an older sister’s choices. Fathers and mothers influence sons but not their daughters, except when a mother majors in the male-dominated program of engineering. Back-of-the-envelope calculations reveal that these within-family spillovers have sizable implications for the sex composition of majors. (JEL I21, J12, J13, J16)
articles.abstract_cn: 本文估计了瑞典高中专业选择中的家庭溢出效应，在瑞典，超额申请专业的录取由GPA决定。利用断点回归设计，我们发现存在显著的兄弟姐妹和代际溢出效应，且这些效应取决于二人组合的性别构成。同性别的兄弟姐妹会相互模仿，而弟弟则会回避姐姐的选择。父亲和母亲影响儿子但不影响女儿，除非母亲主修男性主导的工程专业。粗略计算表明，这些家庭内部的溢出效应对专业的性别构成具有显著影响。(JEL I21, J12, J13, J16)

articles.title_en: The Impact of Legal Abortion on Maternal Mortality
articles.title_cn: 合法堕胎对孕产妇死亡率的影响
articles.abstract_en: Legal abortion has recently been suggested as an essential health care service. In this study, we consider whether abortion legalization over 1969–1973 improved women’s health as measured by maternal mortality. Our event study results indicate that legal abortion substantially lowered non-White maternal mortality by 30–50 percent, with 134 non-White maternal deaths averted nationally in the first year abortion became legal. We also find that early state-level legalizations were crucial and more influential than the Roe v. Wade decision itself. (JEL I12, I18, J13, J16, K10, K38)
articles.abstract_cn: 合法堕胎最近被认为是必要的医疗保健服务。在本研究中，我们考虑1969-1973年间堕胎合法化是否改善了以孕产妇死亡率衡量的女性健康。我们的事件研究结果表明，合法堕胎显著降低了非白人孕产妇死亡率30-50%，在堕胎合法化的第一年，全国避免了134例非白人孕产妇死亡。我们还发现，早期的州级合法化至关重要，且比罗伊诉韦德案本身更具影响力。(JEL I12, I18, J13, J16, K10, K38)

articles.title_en: Firm Donations and Political Rhetoric: Evidence from a National Ban
articles.title_cn: 企业捐赠与政治修辞：来自一项全国性禁令的证据
articles.abstract_en: We study France’s 1995 ban on firm donations to politicians. We use a difference-in-differences approach and a novel dataset combining the campaign manifestos issued by candidates running in French parliamentary elections with data on their campaign contributions. We show that banning firm donations discourages candidates from advertising their local presence during the campaign, as well as economic issues. The ban also leads candidates from nonmainstream parties to use more extreme language. This suggests that private donors shape politicians’ topics of interest, and that campaign finance reforms may affect the information made available to voters through their impact on candidates’ rhetoric. (JEL D22, D72, D83, K16)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了法国1995年对企业向政治家捐赠的禁令。我们采用双重差分方法，并结合一个新颖的数据集，该数据集将法国议会选举中候选人发布的竞选宣言与其竞选捐款数据相结合。我们表明，禁止企业捐赠会抑制候选人在竞选期间宣传其地方存在以及经济议题。该禁令还导致非主流政党候选人使用更极端的语言。这表明私人捐赠者塑造了政治家关注的议题，并且竞选资金改革可能通过影响候选人的修辞来影响选民可获得的信息。(JEL D22, D72, D83, K16)

articles.title_en: The Effects of a Large-Scale Mental Health Reform: Evidence from Brazil
articles.title_cn: 大规模心理健康改革的效果：来自巴西的证据
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies the Brazilian Psychiatric Reform, which reorganized the public mental health care provision by introducing mental health centers (CAPS) as a community-based substitute for inpatient care. Our research design exploits the rollout of CAPS in a difference-in-differences framework. We show that these centers increased outpatient mental health care production and reduced psychiatric hospitalizations. These reductions were more pronounced for long-stay admissions and among patients with schizophrenia. We find that the savings implied by fewer admissions do not offset the cost of the policy. Also, the reform did not reduce mental health mortality and it increased violent crimes. (JEL H51, I12, I18, O15)
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了巴西精神病学改革，该改革通过引入心理健康中心（CAPS）作为住院护理的社区替代方案，重组了公共心理健康护理的提供。我们的研究设计利用了CAPS在双重差分框架中的推广。我们表明，这些中心增加了门诊心理健康护理的产出，并减少了精神病住院。这些减少在长期住院和精神病患者中更为明显。我们发现，因住院减少而节省的费用并未抵消政策成本。此外，改革并未降低心理健康死亡率，反而增加了暴力犯罪。（JEL H51, I12, I18, O15）

articles.title_en: Tripping through Hoops: The Effect of Violating Compulsory Government Procedures
articles.title_cn: 穿越铁环：违反强制性政府程序的影响
articles.abstract_en: Millions of Americans must navigate complex government procedures under the threat of punishment. Violating these requirements can lead to poverty traps or deepening legal system involvement. We use a field experiment to estimate the effect of failing to appear for court on subsequent legal contact. The treatments reduce failure to appear by 40 percent. Using treatment assignment to identify the causal impact of minor procedural violations, we find no effect on arrests. However, for lower-level cases, violations increase fines and fees paid by 59 percent or $79, equivalent to a high-interest loan, showing that minor procedural violations can be costly. (JEL C93, D73, K14, K41)
articles.abstract_cn: 数百万美国人必须在惩罚威胁下应对复杂的政府程序。违反这些要求可能导致贫困陷阱或加深法律体系的介入。我们通过一项实地实验来估计未能出庭对后续法律接触的影响。处理措施将未能出庭率降低了40%。利用处理分配来识别轻微程序违规的因果影响，我们发现对逮捕没有影响。然而，对于较低级别的案件，违规行为使支付的罚款和费用增加了59%或$79，相当于一笔高息贷款，表明轻微程序违规可能代价高昂。（JEL C93, D73, K14, K41）

articles.title_en: How Do Copayment Coupons Affect Branded Drug Prices and Quantities Purchased?
articles.title_cn: 共付额优惠券如何影响品牌药价格和购买数量？
articles.abstract_en: We estimate the causal effects of drug copayment coupons, which reduce consumer cost sharing for branded prescription drugs, on net-of-rebate price and quantities sold. We show that coupon introductions increase the quantity of drugs without generic substitutes sold by 23–25 percent for the commercial segment relative to Medicare Advantage, where coupons are banned. To quantify the resulting equilibrium price effects, we estimate a discrete choice model of demand for multiple sclerosis drugs and simulate a model of drug price negotiations. We estimate that net-of-rebate prices are 8 percent higher due to coupons being offered for most of these drugs. (JEL G22, I18, L65)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们估计了药品共付额优惠券（即降低品牌处方药消费者自付部分的优惠券）对扣除返利后价格和销售数量的因果效应。我们发现，相对于禁止使用优惠券的Medicare Advantage计划，优惠券的引入使商业保险细分市场中无仿制药替代品的药品数量增加了23-25%。为了量化由此产生的均衡价格效应，我们估计了一个多发性硬化症药物的离散选择需求模型，并模拟了一个药品价格谈判模型。我们估计，由于这些药物中大多数都提供优惠券，扣除返利后的价格高出8%。（JEL G22, I18, L65）

articles.title_en: Indirect Savings from Public Procurement Centralization
articles.title_cn: 公共采购集中化的间接节约
articles.abstract_en: Centralization of public procurement can lower prices for the government’s direct purchase of goods and services. This paper focuses on indirect savings. Public administrations that do not procure directly through a central procurement agency might benefit from the availability of centrally procured goods. We exploit the introduction of a central purchasing agency in Italy and find that prices came down by 22 percent among administrations that bought autonomously. These indirect effects appear to be driven by informational externalities, especially for less competent public buyers purchasing technologically more complex goods. Accounting for indirect savings increases the estimate of direct ones. (JEL D83, H57, H83)
articles.abstract_cn: 公共采购的集中化可以降低政府直接采购商品和服务的价格。本文关注的是间接节约。不通过中央采购机构直接采购的公共管理部门，可能会受益于中央集中采购商品的可得性。我们利用意大利引入中央采购机构的情况，发现在自主采购的部门中，价格下降了22%。这些间接效应似乎是由信息外部性驱动的，尤其是对于能力较弱的公共买家购买技术更复杂的商品时。考虑间接节约会提高直接节约的估计值。(JEL D83, H57, H83)

articles.title_en: Shaping the Habits of Teen Drivers
articles.abstract_en: We show that a targeted law can modify teens’ risky behavior. We examine the effects of an Australian intervention banning first-year drivers from driving late at night with multiple peers, which had accounted for one-fifth of their traffic fatalities. Using data on individual drivers linked to crash outcomes, we find the reform more than halves targeted crashes, casualties and deaths. There are large positive spillovers through lower crashes earlier in the evening and beyond the first year, suggesting broad and persistent declines in high-risk driving. Overall, the targeted intervention delivers gains comparable to harsher restrictions that delay teen driving. (JEL D91, J13, K32, R41)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们表明，一项有针对性的法律可以改变青少年的冒险行为。我们考察了澳大利亚一项干预措施的效果，该措施禁止第一年驾龄的司机在深夜与多名同龄人一起驾驶，而这一行为曾占其交通死亡人数的五分之一。利用与事故结果相关联的个体驾驶员数据，我们发现该改革使目标事故、伤亡和死亡人数减少了一半以上。通过傍晚早些时候及第一年之后事故率的降低，存在巨大的正向溢出效应，表明高风险驾驶行为出现了广泛而持续的下降。总体而言，有针对性的干预措施带来的收益与延迟青少年驾驶的更严格限制相当。(JEL D91, J13, K32, R41)

articles.title_en: Optimal Internality Taxation of Product Attributes
articles.title_cn: 产品属性的最优内部性税收
articles.abstract_en: This paper explores how a benevolent policymaker should optimally tax (or subsidize) product attributes when consumers are behaviorally biased. We demonstrate that market choices are informative about biases, which can be exploited for targeting biased consumers via a nonlinear tax schedule. We show that the properties of this schedule depend on few parameters of the joint distribution of consumer valuations and biases. Furthermore, we provide a novel justification for behaviorally motivated product standards and derive when a combination of taxes and standards is optimal. We illustrate our findings based on a numerical example from the lightbulb market. (JEL D82, D91, H21, H25, L69)
articles.abstract_cn: 本文探讨了当消费者存在行为偏差时，一位仁慈的政策制定者应如何对产品属性进行最优征税（或补贴）。我们证明，市场选择能够提供关于偏差的信息，这可用于通过非线性税收计划来针对有偏差的消费者。我们表明，该计划的属性取决于消费者估值与偏差联合分布的少数参数。此外，我们为行为动机驱动的产品标准提供了新的理由，并推导出何时税收与标准的组合是最优的。我们通过灯泡市场的一个数值例子来说明我们的发现。（JEL D82, D91, H21, H25, L69）

articles.title_en: Rural Roads, Farm Labor Exits, and Crop Fires
articles.title_cn: 农村道路、农业劳动力退出与秸秆焚烧
articles.abstract_en: Even as policymakers seek to encourage economic development by addressing misallocation due to frictions in labor markets, the associated production externalities—such as air pollution—remain unexplored. Using a regression discontinuity design, we show access to rural roads increases agricultural fires and particulate emissions. Farm labor exits are a likely mechanism: rural roads cause movement of workers out of agriculture and induce farmers to use fire—a labor-saving but polluting technology—to clear agricultural residue or to make harvesting less labor-intensive. Overall, the adoption of fires due to rural roads increases infant mortality rates by 5.5 percent in downwind locations. (JEL D62, J43, O13, O18, Q12, Q51, Q53)
articles.abstract_cn: 尽管政策制定者试图通过解决劳动力市场摩擦导致的资源错配来鼓励经济发展，但相关的生产外部性——如空气污染——仍未得到探讨。利用断点回归设计，我们表明农村道路的通行增加了农业焚烧和颗粒物排放。农业劳动力退出是一个可能的机制：农村道路导致工人从农业中转移出来，并促使农民使用焚烧——一种节省劳动力但污染的技术——来清理农业残留物或减少收割的劳动密集度。总体而言，由于农村道路导致的焚烧采用使下风向地区的婴儿死亡率增加了5.5%。（JEL D62, J43, O13, O18, Q12, Q51, Q53）

articles.title_en: Government Transfers and Votes for State Intervention
articles.title_cn: 政府转移支付与国家干预投票
articles.abstract_en: Government transfers might have long-lasting consequences on electoral outcomes. We study a regional policy implemented in Italy over the second half of the twentieth century and leverage variation in transfers to show that parties promoting more state intervention in the economy performed better in the targeted areas relative to places that were not subsidized, decades after the end of the policy. This effect does not seem to mirror long-term differences in the economic performance of treated and control areas, which were small, nor other attitudes within the electorate. (JEL D72, H76, I38, N34, N44, R53)
articles.abstract_cn: 政府转移支付可能对选举结果产生长期影响。我们研究了二十世纪下半叶在意大利实施的一项区域政策，利用转移支付的差异来表明，在政策结束几十年后，相对于未受补贴的地区，主张更多国家干预经济的政党在目标地区的表现更好。这种效应似乎并不反映处理组和对照组地区在经济表现上的长期差异（这些差异很小），也不反映选民中的其他态度。（JEL D72, H76, I38, N34, N44, R53）

articles.title_en: Competitive Bidding in Drug Procurement: Evidence from China
articles.title_cn: 药品采购中的竞争性招标：来自中国的证据
articles.abstract_en: We study the equilibrium effects of introducing competitive bidding in drug procurement. In 2019, China introduced a competitive bidding program where drug companies bid for a prespecified procurement quantity in nine provinces. Using a difference-in-differences design, we show the program reduced average drug prices by 47.4 percent. Generic drugs won most bids and cut prices by 75.0 percent. We develop an equilibrium model to quantify the trade-off between lower prices and potential choice distortions. Competitive bidding increases consumer welfare if policymakers believe consumers should value branded and bioequivalent generic drugs equally. The program also reduced government expenditure on insurance by 19.8 percent. (JEL D44, G22, I18, L13, L65, P25, P31)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了在药品采购中引入竞争性招标的均衡效应。2019年，中国在九个省份引入了一项竞争性招标计划，药品公司对预设的采购数量进行投标。使用双重差分设计，我们表明该计划使平均药品价格降低了47.4%。仿制药赢得了大多数投标，并将价格降低了75.0%。我们开发了一个均衡模型来量化较低价格与潜在选择扭曲之间的权衡。如果政策制定者认为消费者应同等重视品牌药和生物等效仿制药，则竞争性招标会增加消费者福利。该计划还使政府在保险上的支出减少了19.8%。（JEL D44, G22, I18, L13, L65, P25, P31）
